// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
// Package node implements an isolated SDK transport, never a signer authority.
package node

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"sync"

	pb "go.etcd.io/etcd/api/v3/etcdserverpb"
	clientv3 "go.etcd.io/etcd/client/v3"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
)

var (
	ErrAdapterInvalid   = errors.New("invalid adapter request or response")
	ErrAdapterConflict  = errors.New("CAS conflict or different request contents")
	ErrAdapterUncertain = errors.New("outcome uncertain: inspection only, no resubmit")
	ErrAdapterFaulted   = errors.New("adapter faulted: no automatic recovery")
	ErrAdapterAttempted = errors.New("operation already attempted: lookup only")
)

// Existing BuildHeadEtcdTxn/ValidateHeadEtcdPlan and authenticated v2 verification
// remain the caller's responsibility. No no-op/default verifier is supplied.
// In the original node package pass ValidateHeadEtcdPlan, without modification.
type HeadPlanVerifier func(HeadEtcdScope, HeadEtcdTxn) error

type SDKHeadAdapter struct {
	mu        sync.Mutex
	kv        clientv3.KV
	scope     HeadEtcdScope
	root      string
	verify    HeadPlanVerifier
	minimum   int64
	attempted map[string][]byte
	faulted   bool
}

var _ HeadEtcdTransportContract = (*SDKHeadAdapter)(nil)

// kv must come from a separately reviewed TLS/RBAC client. This constructor
// neither dials nor treats an injected KV or a cluster ID as authentication.
func NewSDKHeadAdapter(kv clientv3.KV, s HeadEtcdScope, verify HeadPlanVerifier) (*SDKHeadAdapter, error) {
	if kv == nil || verify == nil {
		return nil, ErrAdapterInvalid
	}
	root, e := HeadEtcdRoot(s)
	if e != nil {
		return nil, e
	}
	return &SDKHeadAdapter{kv: kv, scope: s, root: root, verify: verify, attempted: make(map[string][]byte)}, nil
}

func (a *SDKHeadAdapter) validKey(k string) bool {
	if k == a.root+"binding" || k == a.root+"head" {
		return true
	}
	tail := strings.TrimPrefix(k, a.root)
	if tail == k {
		return false
	}
	parts := strings.Split(tail, "/")
	if len(parts) == 2 && parts[0] == "operations" {
		return journalHex(parts[1], 16)
	}
	return len(parts) == 3 && parts[0] == "requests" && journalHex(parts[1], 16) && (parts[2] == "claim" || parts[2] == "INTENT" || parts[2] == "COMPLETE")
}

func (a *SDKHeadAdapter) header(h *pb.ResponseHeader) error {
	if h == nil || h.Revision <= 0 || h.Revision < a.minimum || fmt.Sprintf("%016x", h.ClusterId) != a.scope.ClusterID {
		return ErrAdapterInvalid
	}
	a.minimum = h.Revision
	return nil
}

// Multi-key read-only Txn gives one response snapshot. No serializable,
// historical, cache, prefix, lease, or failure-write fallback is used.
func (a *SDKHeadAdapter) RangeCurrent(ctx context.Context, s HeadEtcdScope, keys []string) (HeadEtcdRead, error) {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()
	var out HeadEtcdRead
	if s != a.scope || len(keys) < 2 || len(keys) > 8 {
		return out, ErrAdapterInvalid
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	ops := make([]clientv3.Op, 0, len(keys))
	for _, k := range keys {
		if !a.validKey(k) || seen[k] {
			return out, ErrAdapterInvalid
		}
		seen[k] = true
		ops = append(ops, clientv3.OpGet(k))
	}
	if !seen[a.root+"binding"] || !seen[a.root+"head"] {
		return out, ErrAdapterInvalid
	}
	r, e := a.kv.Txn(ctx).Then(ops...).Commit()
	if e != nil {
		return out, e
	}
	if r == nil || !r.Succeeded || len(r.Responses) != len(keys) {
		return out, ErrAdapterInvalid
	}
	if e = a.header(r.Header); e != nil {
		return out, e
	}
	out = HeadEtcdRead{ClusterID: s.ClusterID, HeaderRevision: r.Header.Revision}
	var size int
	for i, op := range r.Responses {
		if op == nil {
			return HeadEtcdRead{}, ErrAdapterInvalid
		}
		rr := op.GetResponseRange()
		if rr == nil || rr.More || rr.Count != int64(len(rr.Kvs)) || len(rr.Kvs) > 1 {
			return HeadEtcdRead{}, ErrAdapterInvalid
		}
		if rr.Header != nil && (rr.Header.Revision != r.Header.Revision || rr.Header.ClusterId != r.Header.ClusterId) {
			return HeadEtcdRead{}, ErrAdapterInvalid
		}
		for _, kv := range rr.Kvs {
			if kv == nil || string(kv.Key) != keys[i] || kv.Lease != 0 || kv.Version <= 0 || kv.CreateRevision <= 0 || kv.ModRevision < kv.CreateRevision || kv.ModRevision > r.Header.Revision {
				return HeadEtcdRead{}, ErrAdapterInvalid
			}
			size += len(kv.Key) + len(kv.Value)
			if size > s.MaxTxnBytes {
				return HeadEtcdRead{}, ErrAdapterInvalid
			}
			out.KVs = append(out.KVs, HeadEtcdKV{Key: string(kv.Key), Value: bytes.Clone(kv.Value), CreateRevision: kv.CreateRevision, ModRevision: kv.ModRevision, Version: kv.Version})
		}
	}
	binding, _ := headEtcdBindingBytes(s)
	b, ok := headEtcdGet(out, a.root+"binding")
	if !ok || !bytes.Equal(b.Value, binding) {
		return HeadEtcdRead{}, ErrAdapterInvalid
	}
	if _, ok = headEtcdGet(out, a.root+"head"); !ok {
		return HeadEtcdRead{}, ErrAdapterInvalid
	}
	return out, nil
}

func clonePlan(p HeadEtcdTxn) HeadEtcdTxn {
	q := HeadEtcdTxn{Root: p.Root}
	for _, c := range p.Compare {
		c.Value = bytes.Clone(c.Value)
		q.Compare = append(q.Compare, c)
	}
	for _, v := range p.Put {
		v.Value = bytes.Clone(v.Value)
		q.Put = append(q.Put, v)
	}
	return q
}

// Verifies transport shape in addition to the REQUIRED contract validator.
// Receipt signatures and semantic HRS/epoch checks are NOT reimplemented here.
func (a *SDKHeadAdapter) plan(p HeadEtcdTxn) (string, []clientv3.Cmp, []clientv3.Op, error) {
	if e := a.verify(a.scope, p); e != nil {
		return "", nil, nil, e
	}
	if p.Root != a.root || len(p.Compare) < 4 || len(p.Put) < 2 || len(p.Compare) > 16 || len(p.Put) > 4 {
		return "", nil, nil, ErrAdapterInvalid
	}
	cmps := []clientv3.Cmp{}
	ops := []clientv3.Op{}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	putKeys := map[string]bool{}
	var opid string
	for _, put := range p.Put {
		if !a.validKey(put.Key) || put.Key == a.root+"binding" || put.Lease != 0 || putKeys[put.Key] {
			return "", nil, nil, ErrAdapterInvalid
		}
		putKeys[put.Key] = true
		if strings.HasPrefix(put.Key, a.root+"operations/") {
			if opid != "" {
				return "", nil, nil, ErrAdapterInvalid
			}
			opid = strings.TrimPrefix(put.Key, a.root+"operations/")
		}
		ops = append(ops, clientv3.OpPut(put.Key, string(put.Value)))
	}
	if opid == "" || !putKeys[a.root+"head"] {
		return "", nil, nil, ErrAdapterInvalid
	}
	for _, c := range p.Compare {
		tag := c.Key + "\x00" + c.Target
		if !a.validKey(c.Key) || seen[tag] {
			return "", nil, nil, ErrAdapterInvalid
		}
		seen[tag] = true
		switch c.Target {
		case "VALUE":
			if c.Number != 0 {
				return "", nil, nil, ErrAdapterInvalid
			}
			cmps = append(cmps, clientv3.Compare(clientv3.Value(c.Key), "=", string(c.Value)))
		case "MOD":
			if c.Number <= 0 || len(c.Value) != 0 {
				return "", nil, nil, ErrAdapterInvalid
			}
			cmps = append(cmps, clientv3.Compare(clientv3.ModRevision(c.Key), "=", c.Number))
		case "VERSION":
			if c.Number != 0 || len(c.Value) != 0 {
				return "", nil, nil, ErrAdapterInvalid
			}
			cmps = append(cmps, clientv3.Compare(clientv3.Version(c.Key), "=", int64(0)))
		default:
			return "", nil, nil, ErrAdapterInvalid
		}
	}
	for _, tag := range []string{a.root + "binding\x00VALUE", a.root + "head\x00VALUE", a.root + "head\x00MOD", a.root + "operations/" + opid + "\x00VERSION"} {
		if !seen[tag] {
			return "", nil, nil, ErrAdapterInvalid
		}
	}
	for _, put := range p.Put {
		if strings.HasPrefix(put.Key, a.root+"requests/") && !strings.HasSuffix(put.Key, "/claim") && !seen[put.Key+"\x00VERSION"] {
			return "", nil, nil, ErrAdapterInvalid
		}
		if strings.HasSuffix(put.Key, "/claim") && !seen[put.Key+"\x00VERSION"] {
			return "", nil, nil, ErrAdapterInvalid
		}
	}
	// Actual protobuf request size and operation count, not just JSON estimate.
	req := &pb.TxnRequest{}
	for i := range cmps {
		req.Compare = append(req.Compare, cmps[i].GetCompare())
	}
	for _, p := range p.Put {
		req.Success = append(req.Success, &pb.RequestOp{Request: &pb.RequestOp_RequestPut{RequestPut: &pb.PutRequest{Key: []byte(p.Key), Value: p.Value}}})
	}
	if proto.Size(req) > a.scope.MaxTxnBytes {
		return "", nil, nil, ErrAdapterInvalid
	}
	return opid, cmps, ops, nil
}

// One Commit at most per operation. An ambiguous write permanently faults this
// instance for further writes; no API resets that state. Reconcile stays read-only.
func (a *SDKHeadAdapter) Txn(ctx context.Context, s HeadEtcdScope, input HeadEtcdTxn) (HeadEtcdTxnResult, error) {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()
	var out HeadEtcdTxnResult
	if s != a.scope {
		return out, ErrAdapterInvalid
	}
	p := clonePlan(input)
	id, cmps, ops, e := a.plan(p)
	if e != nil {
		return out, e
	}
	encoded, _ := json.Marshal(p)
	if prev, ok := a.attempted[id]; ok {
		if !bytes.Equal(prev, encoded) {
			return out, ErrAdapterConflict
		}
		return out, ErrAdapterAttempted
	}
	if a.faulted {
		return out, ErrAdapterFaulted
	}
	if e = ctx.Err(); e != nil {
		return out, e
	}
	a.attempted[id] = encoded
	r, e := a.kv.Txn(ctx).If(cmps...).Then(ops...).Commit()
	if e != nil {
		a.faulted = true
		return out, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrAdapterUncertain, e)
	}
	if r == nil || a.header(r.Header) != nil {
		a.faulted = true
		return out, ErrAdapterUncertain
	}
	if !r.Succeeded {
		if len(r.Responses) != 0 {
			a.faulted = true
			return out, ErrAdapterUncertain
		}
		return HeadEtcdTxnResult{Succeeded: false, HeaderRevision: r.Header.Revision, ClusterID: s.ClusterID}, nil
	}
	if len(r.Responses) != len(p.Put) {
		a.faulted = true
		return out, ErrAdapterUncertain
	}
	for _, v := range r.Responses {
		if v == nil || v.GetResponsePut() == nil {
			a.faulted = true
			return out, ErrAdapterUncertain
		}
	}
	return HeadEtcdTxnResult{Succeeded: true, HeaderRevision: r.Header.Revision, ClusterID: s.ClusterID}, nil
}

type HeadAdapterOutcome struct {
	Status                 string
	Confirmed              bool
	Read                   HeadEtcdRead
	AllowSigning           bool `json:"allow_signing"`
	RecoveryAuthorized     bool `json:"recovery_authorized"`
	SigningHistoryComplete bool `json:"signing_history_complete"`
}

// A matching immutable receipt is historical evidence, not latestness or signing
// permission. If Head advanced, this deliberately returns an error and history-only
// status; it does not infer a valid descendant or authorize replay/recovery.
func (a *SDKHeadAdapter) Reconcile(ctx context.Context, input HeadEtcdTxn) (HeadAdapterOutcome, error) {
	p := clonePlan(input)
	a.mu.Lock()
	_, _, _, e := a.plan(p)
	a.mu.Unlock()
	if e != nil {
		return HeadAdapterOutcome{Status: "invalid-plan"}, e
	}
	keys := []string{a.root + "binding", a.root + "head"}
	for _, v := range p.Put {
		if v.Key != a.root+"head" {
			keys = append(keys, v.Key)
		}
	}
	for _, c := range p.Compare {
		if strings.HasSuffix(c.Key, "/claim") {
			found := false
			for _, k := range keys {
				if k == c.Key {
					found = true
				}
			}
			if !found {
				keys = append(keys, c.Key)
			}
		}
	}
	r, e := a.RangeCurrent(ctx, a.scope, keys)
	out := HeadAdapterOutcome{Status: "unresolved", Read: r}
	if e != nil {
		return out, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrAdapterUncertain, e)
	}
	count, total := 0, 0
	for _, v := range p.Put {
		if v.Key == a.root+"head" {
			continue
		}
		total++
		if kv, ok := headEtcdGet(r, v.Key); ok {
			count++
			if !bytes.Equal(kv.Value, v.Value) {
				out.Status = "request-content-conflict"
				return out, ErrAdapterConflict
			}
		}
	}
	if count < total {
		if count != 0 {
			out.Status = "incomplete-receipt-set"
			return out, ErrAdapterUncertain
		}
		head, _ := headEtcdGet(r, a.root+"head")
		for _, c := range p.Compare {
			if c.Key == a.root+"head" && ((c.Target == "VALUE" && !bytes.Equal(head.Value, c.Value)) || (c.Target == "MOD" && head.ModRevision != c.Number)) {
				out.Status = "head-conflict"
				return out, ErrAdapterConflict
			}
		}
		return out, ErrAdapterUncertain
	}
	var revision int64
	for _, v := range p.Put {
		if v.Key == a.root+"head" {
			continue
		}
		kv, ok := headEtcdGet(r, v.Key)
		if !ok {
			return out, ErrAdapterUncertain
		}
		if !bytes.Equal(kv.Value, v.Value) {
			out.Status = "request-content-conflict"
			return out, ErrAdapterConflict
		}
		if revision == 0 {
			revision = kv.ModRevision
		}
		if kv.ModRevision != revision || kv.CreateRevision != kv.ModRevision || kv.Version != 1 {
			out.Status = "incomplete-or-rewritten-receipt"
			return out, ErrAdapterUncertain
		}
	}
	for _, c := range p.Compare {
		if strings.HasSuffix(c.Key, "/claim") {
			kv, ok := headEtcdGet(r, c.Key)
			if !ok || (c.Target == "VALUE" && !bytes.Equal(kv.Value, c.Value)) || (c.Target == "MOD" && kv.ModRevision != c.Number) {
				out.Status = "claim-mismatch"
				return out, ErrAdapterUncertain
			}
		}
	}
	head, _ := headEtcdGet(r, a.root+"head")
	for _, v := range p.Put {
		if v.Key == a.root+"head" && (!bytes.Equal(head.Value, v.Value) || head.ModRevision != revision) {
			out.Status = "historical-receipt-head-differs"
			return out, ErrAdapterUncertain
		}
	}
	out.Status = "confirmed-head-and-receipts"
	out.Confirmed = true
	return out, nil
}

// lookupCtx must be caller-supplied and bounded, independent of an expired write
// context if necessary. This function never changes Expected or resubmits a CAS.
func (a *SDKHeadAdapter) Apply(ctx, lookupCtx context.Context, p HeadEtcdTxn) (HeadAdapterOutcome, error) {
	// Lookup first: an existing same request returns evidence without any CAS.
	existing, e := a.Reconcile(lookupCtx, p)
	if e == nil {
		return existing, nil
	}
	if errors.Is(e, ErrAdapterConflict) {
		return existing, e
	}
	// A missing receipt alone is not a general retry grant. Txn permits only a
	// first attempt in this instance; durable cross-restart submission gating is
	// an external service requirement, not implemented by this transport.
	if existing.Status != "unresolved" {
		return existing, e
	}
	if existing.Read.HeaderRevision == 0 {
		return existing, e
	}
	result, writeErr := a.Txn(ctx, a.scope, p)
	if writeErr != nil || !result.Succeeded {
		observed, readErr := a.Reconcile(lookupCtx, p)
		if readErr == nil {
			return observed, nil
		}
		if writeErr != nil {
			return observed, writeErr
		}
		return observed, ErrAdapterConflict
	}
	return a.Reconcile(lookupCtx, p)
}
